name: Moonglade
summary: A young tauren druid learns to reach nature’s ancient keepers in Moonglade. Guided by Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, you learn to cross the waking world and commune with them directly.

sections.title: A Sacred Haven Beyond Faction
sections.body: Beyond Kalimdor’s faction struggles, Moonglade offers a refuge to all who follow nature. Keeper Remulos, son of Cenarius, watches over the ancient valley. Night elf and tauren druids enter Nighthaven as equals beneath the Cenarion Circle’s timeless mantle.

sections.title: The Leap Across Kalimdor
sections.body: Turak Runetotem teaches you a transport spell bound to Moonglade. It aids your spiritual and martial growth, carrying you across hundreds of leagues in a heartbeat through your bond with the natural world. The valley gives you a place to study and a lasting refuge throughout your journey.

sections.title: Awakening the Bear
sections.body: In Nighthaven, you meet Dendrite Starblaze, an elder night elf druid who awaits new pupils. Under his guidance, you begin the first true trial of your calling: learning the bear’s perspective. To embrace the ways of the Claw, prove your strength, courage, and balance before the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Why can tauren visit a night elf haven like Moonglade?
faq.answer: Moonglade is sacred ground guided by the Cenarion Circle. There, devotion to nature and Cenarius takes precedence over the conflict between the Horde and Alliance, allowing tauren and night elf druids to train and dwell together in peace.
Dendrite Starblaze is an elder night elf druid in Nighthaven. He mentors newly arrived initiates of both races and guides their early trials as they attune to the ancient animal aspects.

Keeper Remulos is a mighty Keeper of the Grove and son of Cenarius. He is Moonglade’s supreme guardian, watching over the sacred barrows where sleeping druids hibernate and protecting the valley’s sanctity.

Speaking with Dendrite Starblaze begins your trial with the Great Bear Spirit. He sends you to the spirit’s home in northwestern Moonglade to learn strength of body and heart, the first step toward unlocking bear form.

faq.q: How does Teleport: Moonglade work lore-wise?
faq.answer: Druids weave natural ley energies and their spiritual bond with the Cenarion Circle to cross instantly from wherever they stand to Moonglade’s heart. Teleport: Moonglade anchors them there, letting them return for instruction and solace whenever summoned.
Turak Runetotem resides atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He mentors young tauren who heed the call of the wild before sending them onward to Moonglade.

angles.text: As a druid, this rite of passage joins traditional tribal beliefs with the broader teachings of the Cenarion Circle. It opens the way to ancient shapeshifting forms.
As a tauren, arriving in Moonglade is a profound awakening. Your ancient ties to the Earth Mother align with the teachings of Cenarius.
As a Horde druid, you can meet night elf druids peacefully in Moonglade, one of the few places in Kalimdor where this is possible.
